encoding: mapunits keyed by client/soils.png R (soils/classes.json); rgb: the dry surface soil's linear sRGB reflectance; litter_share: litter / (litter + bare ground) between the plants

rules.colour: the first mineral horizon of the largest non-miscellaneous component's Official Series Description (dry), else its soil order's typical surface (DEFAULT_BY_ORDER), else SoilGrids organic carbon (dry value 6.5 - 1.6 log2(1 + SOC %), 10YR, chroma 3)
rules.munsell: ASTM D1535 value, chroma x (3.8 + 0.4 value) in CIELAB, hue by the renotation's angles at value 5; Lab D65 to linear sRGB
rules.litter_share: litter / (litter + bare ground), the middles of the component's NRCS ecological site reference sheet ranges (EDIT); else the tile's sheet-weighted mean
rules.ground: the surface by the sheets (plant canopy, litter, bare ground, crust: range middles, as shares of their sum), weighted by component share; units without a sheet the tile's area-weighted mean
rules.crust: biological crust and moss, dry: a stated dark grey-green chip (CRUST_COLOUR)
